verdict.rationale: Runpod documents its own REST API v1 reference, and a runtime probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is served at rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json. The GraphQL docs provide cURL and GraphQL examples users can copy and run. However, nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive (an in-browser try-it console or playground). Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable examples across the REST reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Runpod REST API v1 provides programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources.
Create, start, stop, and query Pods using the GraphQL API with cURL and GraphQL examples.
https://rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json serves the REST API's OpenAPI spec keylessly
